caption: The drawing features a single, detailed object centered within a faint bordered square on a plain, off-white background. The object depicted is a monochrome, intricately drawn tankard or lidded stein, rendered in shades of grey using fine pencil work. The tankard has a cylindrical body with vertical panel details, a round, elevated base, and a conical, perforated lid topped with a small finial. Attached to one side is a pronounced, curved handle ending in a tightly coiled decorative scroll. There is a square border drawn around the tankard, and in the lower right corner of the sheet, outside the bordered area, the name "AARON FASTOVSKY" is written in uppercase letters. The entire composition is primarily composed of grayscale pencil marks, with no color except the natural tone of the paper.
title: Silver Salt Cellar
